title: Green Goddess Chicken & Chickpea Salad
description: A no-cook lunch of shredded chicken, chickpeas and crunchy slaw tossed in a herby green dressing.
steps: Blend the mayo, herbs, lemon juice and garlic into a dressing, then stir in the yogurt.
Toss the slaw with the chicken, chickpeas and dressing.
Top with extra herbs before serving.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste green goddess chicken salad

notes: Chicken plus chickpeas is a double-protein hit that keeps hunger at bay for four-plus hours.
